dedupe_keys.name: cisa chemical facility anti terrorism standards cfats appendix a chemicals of interest and program statistics archived

description: Archived pages of the US programme that screened chemical facilities for terrorism risk. The CISA pages say a chemical facility under CFATS was any establishment holding any of more than 300 chemicals of interest listed in Appendix A above a screening threshold quantity and concentration; CISA decided which facilities were high-risk, placed them in tiers 1 to 4 and approved their security plans, across chemical manufacturing, storage and distribution, energy and utilities, agriculture and food, explosives, mining, electronics, universities, healthcare and pharmaceuticals. The statistics page says CISA received more than 108,000 Top-Screen submissions from more than 45,000 facilities and covered 3,242 facilities, with counts of inspections since inception and for June 2023. The pages are free to read online as HTML, with downloadable fact sheets, marked as archived content, and state that Congress let the programme's authority expire on 28 July 2023. Coverage is the United States. Caveats: no facility list is published, the statistics stop in 2023, and no licence is stated. For simulation it gives the chemical list and thresholds that define high-risk sites and the national scale of such sites, for security and attack scenarios. A related catalogue record is the EPA Risk Management Plan information.
